hero.description: The U.S. Navy heavy cruiser USS Newport News (CA-148) firing on North Vietnamese positions on Cồn Cỏ Island (Tiger island) off Cửa Việt, Vietnam, 27 June 1972. She supported a landing of of South Vietnamese Marines.
categories: Naval shore bombardment in the Vietnam War
